text:
andrew: Quick check — I'm planning to enable the int4 precision toggle for the /embed-serve route to a 10% canary at 12:30 PT today. Need confirmation on guardrails and a QA sign-off before the flip.

leah: ok, couple quick Qs: what's the fallback behavior if quality drops? and are we doing route-level or model-level flag? :thinking:

andrew: fallback -> automatic model-variant fallback: if semantic-similarity-regression > 3% on the eval set OR embedding-distance-drift alarm fires, we auto-route to fp16. It's a route-level toggle (so high-accuracy customers can opt out).

max: +1 on route-level. Also watch: p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, downstream similarity score (mean cosine), and error-rate for inference failures. I'll add checks to the rollout dashboard. :eyes:

rohit: please add an explicit "high_accuracy_opt_out" flag and ensure Dedicated customers with SLA aren't included in canary. We should also gate the canary by license tier.

andrew: good call — will exclude SLA groups. tia, can you produce the canary user list from segments?

tia: SQL snippet to get traffic sample for 10% bucket: 
```sql
SELECT user_id FROM routing_buckets WHERE mod(hash(user_id),100) < 10 AND tier != 'enterprise_sla';
```
That will exclude enterprise customers.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag int4-embed-canary -> ENABLE at 2026-03-17T19:30:00Z for bucket=10%. CI green.

qa-ops: We'll run the quick eval suite on the canary cohort immediately after flip. Plan: 1) 500 prompt similarity checks, 2) 200 downstream retrievals, 3) perf smoke. ETA results 60-90m.

leah: attach the async eval thresholds here please — what tolerances are allowed?

andrew: tolerances: mean cosine drop <= 0.015, top-k retrieval MRR drop <= 1.5%, latency p95 increase <= 25ms, infra errors <= 0.5%. Any alarm should auto-revert.

max: I'll wire an automatic rollback playbook to the canary job: if any of the above triggers, feature flips off and we create incident with tag int4-canary.

rohit: add a human approval hold at 30% ramp. Sequence: 10% (30m hold + QA green), 30% (1h hold, ops review), 60% (2h hold), then 100%.

andrew: agree. Also need CR link and reviewers — pinging @max and @leah for reviews after I push the small config change.

leah: PR is up: https://git.redwood/infer/flags/pull/412 — small validation and rollout policy. @max can you take a look? :pray:

max: reading now. minor nit: change variable name `canary_bucket_pct` -> `canary_percent` for consistency. I'll approve after that.

qa-ops: once flip is live I'll post the eval snapshot and a short table of top 10 prompts that regressed. If anything looks off I'll mark for rollback.

andrew: perfect. I'll wait for approvals and then schedule the flip. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
